column1: # bin/pyi lib-test-all's owned modules (PY6i; the user, 2026-11-03: the families measure their own): FAMILY<TAB>a regex of
# regrtest's module names. lib-test-all leaves them out unless named (--all: every module); its table writes their rows as
# the family's. A module of no line is lib-test-all's own. A "not-run: WHY" line names modules no run runs (CPython's nor pyi's), by design.
not-run: writes /tmp by design (perf-PID.map; the VM forbids /tmp)
